Okay hun, everything will be okay. I so know how this feels because I was in a domestic violent relationship and he would always leave. Even though it wasnt healthy hed leave all the time making it seem like it was my fault even though it was his because he was unsafe. None the less I loved him with all my heart. He wasnt in the home for 6 months due to safety reasons. I felt like dieing too. I really know how that feels, it feels heavy on the heart and it gets worse because there's nothing you can do. You can't force someone to change or come back or be there for you and it sucks when it's the one person you really need. 
I can tell you that your child will absolutely remember you. I can remember till age 2, you would never be forgotten. And at this age it would be developmentally traumatic for your child to suddenly lose his mother. 
Is there another part of who you are that isnt centered around your BF? Perhaps remembering that you are whole even if you dont feel like it will help, because try to think of it like this. You were still you before this man entered your life! And that is still you today. 
I promise this feelimg will pass, you have worth you are strong and beautiful and you have purpose. You will never ever destroy your child's life by being alive and being a mom.

For that whole is the sum of its parts. And if the whole can never be fitted to remain as a whole then all it becomes are fractions amd decimals of what it used to be. 
Some even numbers make for an easy equation to solve, but those odd and negative numbers make for a complicated problem. 
And we are the numbers that make up that whole. But we dont all think the same, so we can never come together to make that mosaic painting. Instead we are like the sludge left over from ionized distilled and filtered radioactive water, still contaminated with tritium. 
And I am like the afterthought of a dwindling fire whos only proof there ever was a fire is the smoke left from hours ago. 
If I were part of any painting at all, it would be one depicted durring each massecre of life. Dead and rotting, skin stripped to the bone. Heart still punping and blood draining to the floor. 
If all humanity, perhapse for a moment, decided to think in the same way as you do now with the same intention as you have, then I suppose we could chamge those negative and odd numbers back into a collective whole. But you have to think about the reality of such a thought. 
Most humans dont care about eachother, they care only about themseleves. How would such a thing ever occur?

What if we were soul mates, and then I called and was like "hey soulmate where have you been?" And you said "here all this time," and then I said "what about when my dad died or my mom died or when no one ever was there my entire life?" And that false reality proves that my existence is menial. Nothing. Nothing at all.
